page.title: Day 12 against Neave's manual
page.standfirst_html: Every flag the comparator raised for Day 12, adjudicated against O.Day.12.16Feb22.pdf — the extracted text for wording, 27 page images for emphasis, colour and block structure, and a word-level and punctuation-level diff of the whole day to catch what similarity scoring rounds away. The course's last page contradicts itself: Deming says the President's medal came “28 years after” the Emperor's, and one line later Neave's quotation of him reads “58 years after”. Two references send the reader somewhere wrong: “Day 9 page 16” was pointed at Day 8, because Day 9 had no anchor for that page, and a documented Workbook-removal rewrite kept half of a Workbook pointer with its page number changed. A whole paragraph on printed p13 is missing, Major Activity 12–e asks for a plan covering “8 to 12 months” where Neave wrote 6, and one of Deming's leadership principles was softened from “will require” to “may require”. Two structural faults are invisible to every automated check: Pause for Thought 12–c prints Neave's commentary before the reader has answered, and a typographic-quote typo in one class attribute means Deming's fourteen principles of leadership have never rendered in his blue. Day 12 also has eighteen emphasis findings, second only to Day 9's, most of them the italics that carry Neave's contrasts.

sections.title: Fix proposed
sections.note_html: Ordered by source page. Eight are marked critical: a wrong number on the last page, a wrong number in the final Major Activity, a wrong-day link, a half-kept Workbook pointer with a wrong page, a missing paragraph, a softened Deming principle, a Pause for Thought that gives its answer away, and the markup typo that stops Deming's list rendering blue. D12-08 and D12-38 each touch one line in a closed day's file (Day 9, Day 1) because a Day 12 link depends on it. D12-03 and D12-22 are Neave's own slips and need docs/deviations/ entries if accepted.

items.source_html: Neave's cross-day ranges on this day: “see Day 9 pages 7–8”, “Major Activity 9–e (Day 9 pages 11–15)” ×2, “Day 5 pages 26–27”, and “(see Day 1 pages 12–13)”.
items.site_html: The first four are unlinked, and none of the five appears in workflow/inter-day-refs.csv.
items.evidence_html: scripts/build-interday-audit.R:125 matches [Dd]ay\s+N\s+page\s+M, so the plural “pages” never matches: “page” followed by “s” fails the \s+. Corpus-wide, “Day N pages M–K” occurs about 96 times and only 6 rows in the CSV contain “pages”. Every cross-day range reference is invisible to the audit #610 relies on — which is also why D12-12's wrong target was never caught. A scripts change, not a content one; hand on as a new issue under #610.
